title: Unit
description: The civic unit designation and address by which a strata lot is commonly known. Separated from StrataLot because the unit number people use often differs from the strata lot number.
x-validationRules: address.unitDesignator should equal unitNumber when both are present.

id.description: Stable identifier of this Unit record.

strataLotId.description: The strata lot this unit corresponds to.

unitNumber.description: Unit number in common use (for example "305").

extensions.description: Implementation-specific data, namespaced by reverse domain.
